title: The Laziest Developer Trick That Saves Thousands
description:
A brand-new free Claude Code skill called Ponytail makes the AI write far less code by forcing it to act like a lazy senior dev, and it cut costs on every model tested. If you want to know how to use Claude Code for less money, this is the fastest win. It checks whether the code even needs to exist before writing anything, so you get the same result with up to 90% less code, lower cost, and 3 to 6 times faster runs across Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus. Nearly 38,000 stars on GitHub. Works whether you're deep into Claude Code workflows or just getting started.

Get the full setup guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OwxScdIOs7HVi6zW6bqe1XhwAYkQiMhF/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
